Description: Archive fetched on Update. Default is the official continuous build. Paste a Discord link for a newer zip. Must contain Server/Linux/.
Linux x64 .NET runtime installed into the instance on first Update. RWMT targets net8.0, so keep an 8.0.x version. Change only if a future build moves to another major version.
Raw argument string appended to the command line. The RWMT server currently takes no arguments, so leave empty unless a build introduces some.
